2d069cde9d2fd655.description: About the Role Cisco Saudi Arabia is seeking a Partner Account Executive for a full-time position in Riyadh. This individual contributor role is responsible for accelerating and scaling Splunk’s business with Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) across the MEA-TRC East region. The role translates the broader EMEA MSP strategy into a focused regional go-to-market and sales execution plan, supporting the development and growth of strategic MSP partnerships. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute the regional MSP sales and go-to-market plan, aligning with the overall EMEA MSP strategy and regional business priorities. Ensure priority partners have a clear MSP strategy and execution plan embedded within broader partner plans. Support Partner Development Managers (PDMs) and Partner Sales Managers (PSMs) in defining MSP growth plans, revenue ambitions, and joint go-to-market activities. Build a clear scale plan to expand the regional MSP ecosystem by onboarding new partners and driving new customer acquisition. Support and drive MSP-related sales and business development activities in collaboration with PDMs, PSMs, and Splunk sales teams. Develop campaigns and initiatives to create MSP pipeline, generate new logos, and support recurring-revenue growth. Lead the regional adoption and execution of the Splunk MSP Program, acting as the regional MSP subject-matter expert. Advise internal teams and partners on MSP commercial models, pricing, contracting, licensing, and partner economics. Build trusted relationships with key MSP stakeholders across executive leadership, sales, technical, service-development, operations, and marketing teams. Support partners in developing and launching differentiated Splunk-powered managed services. Support commercial discussions and negotiations with MSP and MSSP partners, collaborating with EMEA MSP team, legal, finance, and other departments. Required Qualifications Extensive experience working with MSPs, MSSPs, service providers, cloud providers, or technology partners. Deep understanding of the regional MSP and MSSP landscape, business models, customer requirements, and competitive dynamics. Demonstrated success in sales, business development, partner development, or go-to-market roles. Proven ability to translate regional strategies into executable partner and sales plans. Strong understanding of recurring-revenue, consumption-based, managed-service, and partner-led business models. Experience developing and launching partner-led managed services or technology-based service offerings. Strong commercial acumen and experience supporting complex pricing, contracting, and negotiation discussions. Ability to influence stakeholders across partner, sales, technical, executive, regional, and global teams without direct ownership. Strong pipeline management, forecasting, business-planning, and executive communication skills. Knowledge of security, observability, infrastructure monitoring, cloud, or digital-resilience markets is highly desirable. Program Leadership and Enablement This role ensures that Splunk is embedded within partners’ managed security, observability, infrastructure, and digital-resilience service offerings. It involves educating and enabling Splunk sales, partner, and technical teams on the MSP route to market and how to position and execute the program. The Partner Account Executive will also work closely with the EMEA MSP team to identify program improvements required to address regional market needs and partner with the MSP Partner Technical Manager (PTM) to ensure technical alignment and support. Cross-Functional Collaboration The role requires close alignment with Splunk Regional Sales Directors, Regional Sales Managers, AVPs, partner leadership, and other senior stakeholders. Collaboration extends to PDMs, PSMs, PTMs, marketing, legal, finance, operations, and the EMEA and global MSP teams. The Partner Account Executive will prepare and deliver MSP business reviews and updates to regional, EMEA, and partner leadership teams.

2d4a1294fab2efe5.description: About the Role TalentHive is partnering with a prominent Saudi Arabian group, active in the construction, contracting, and industrial sectors, to recruit an Organization Development Supervisor. This full-time position is based in Dammam, Eastern Province, and is designed for an HR professional to contribute to organizational effectiveness and HR framework development within a diversified business. Role Context The Organization Development Supervisor will play a key role in strengthening the organization's effectiveness and supporting its ongoing growth and transformation. This involves contributing to strategic HR initiatives and working closely with business leaders across multiple units to shape workforce and organizational effectiveness. Key Responsibilities Develop and review organizational structures, reporting lines, job descriptions, and role responsibilities. Support organizational design and restructuring initiatives in alignment with business objectives. Drive workforce planning, headcount management, manpower budgeting, and forecasting. Monitor approved versus actual headcount and identify workforce requirements across departments. Develop, implement, and enhance performance management frameworks, including KPIs, goal setting, and performance appraisal processes. Analyze HR data and develop dashboards, reports, and workforce insights to support strategic decision-making. Collaborate with departmental heads and senior stakeholders to improve organizational efficiency and effectiveness. Identify opportunities to enhance existing HR processes, frameworks, and practices. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in Organization Development or a related HR field. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement HR frameworks and processes. Experience in workforce planning and performance management. Career Development This position offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact and take ownership within Organization Development. It provides exposure to multiple business units and strategic HR initiatives, working closely with business leaders to shape workforce and organizational effectiveness. Application Process Candidates seeking to advance their careers within Organization Development and contribute to a growing Saudi business are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

2d8fbbf7e5c40132.description: About SJ Group Surbana Jurong (SJ) Group is a global urban, infrastructure, and engineering consultancy. The company delivers solutions across the built environment and operates in over 40 countries. SJ Group provides multidisciplinary expertise for infrastructure, transportation, aviation, and development projects worldwide. Role Overview SJ Group is seeking a Project Director – Landside / Construction Director to lead construction management and delivery for a major aviation infrastructure project in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires over 10 years of experience and involves providing strategic and operational leadership for landside construction works, ensuring effective project execution and stakeholder coordination. Key Responsibilities Provide overall leadership and direction for landside construction and infrastructure delivery. Lead and manage multidisciplinary construction management teams. Oversee the delivery of landside infrastructure works, including roads, utilities, drainage, access roads, car parks, and associated facilities. Act as a key interface with the client, contractors, consultants, and relevant stakeholders. Oversee construction planning, programme management, progress monitoring, and project controls. Ensure compliance with project specifications, contractual requirements, quality standards, and health and safety regulations. Monitor project performance, budgets, resources, and construction schedules, implementing corrective actions as required. Review and manage contractor submissions, construction methodologies, and technical deliverables. Identify and manage construction risks, interfaces, and potential delivery challenges. Drive effective coordination, timely decision-making, and successful project delivery. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will have over 10 years of experience in construction management, specifically within major infrastructure or aviation projects. This role requires demonstrated leadership in managing complex construction activities and multidisciplinary teams. Work Environment This position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, and is a full-time role within a global, multidisciplinary consultancy. The successful candidate will work alongside experienced professionals on complex aviation and infrastructure projects. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

2de93c7af255b0f1.description: About Meta Electric Meta Electric is a leading manufacturer of electrical switchgear and automation solutions. The company operates a fully integrated, state-of-the-art production facility spanning 20,000 square meters. Meta Electric specializes in low- and medium-voltage switchgear, motor control centers, control and automation panels, engineering services, and high-quality sheet metal enclosures. The company delivers reliable solutions that comply with international quality standards for industrial, commercial, and utility sectors, with a strong commitment to quality backed by ISO 9001:2000 certification. The Role of Estimation Engineer Meta Electric is seeking an Estimation Engineer to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves preparing and reviewing cost estimates for electrical projects, ensuring accuracy and competitiveness. The position requires 0-2 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Prepare and review technical and commercial cost estimates for electrical projects. Analyze project drawings, specifications, Bills of Quantities (BOQs), and tender documents. Prepare quotations and cost breakdowns for Low Voltage (LV) and Medium Voltage (MV) systems. Review and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations. Coordinate with sales, procurement, and technical teams to ensure accurate and competitive pricing. Ensure all estimates comply with project requirements and technical specifications. Required Experience 0-2 years of experience in estimation or a related engineering field. Work Environment and Development The successful candidate will work within a supportive and collaborative environment at Meta Electric. This role offers opportunities to develop technical and professional skills, with exposure to various electrical projects and industry practices. Career growth and professional development opportunities are available within the company.

2d5059d5a45b1714.description: About the Role Tibah Airports Operation is seeking an Aerodrome Operations Inspector to join their team in Medina, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience. The primary purpose of this role is to conduct inspections and monitor airside infrastructure, operations, and activities to ensure safe and efficient airside operations. Role Purpose and Compliance The Aerodrome Operations Inspector ensures compliance with GACAR Part 139 - Aerodromes, applicable ICAO standards, and airport safety procedures. This role is crucial for supporting aerodrome certification, operational safety oversight, continuous regulatory compliance, and the effective delivery of airside operations. Key Responsibilities Conduct daily and periodic airside inspections to verify the operational readiness of runways, taxiways, aprons, and associated safety areas. Monitor runway surface conditions, lighting systems, signage, and pavement markings to ensure compliance with applicable aerodrome standards. Identify and report Foreign Object Debris (FOD), wildlife hazards through regular wildlife monitoring patrols, and obstacle intrusions that may affect aircraft operations. Verify that maintenance and construction activities within the airside area comply with approved safety procedures and applicable work permits. Coordinate with relevant operational teams to initiate NOTAM requests when airfield conditions or ongoing works may affect aircraft operations. Ensure that inspection findings and safety observations are properly documented, tracked, and reported in accordance with applicable aerodrome regulatory requirements. Participate in the Aerodrome Safety Management System (SMS) by reporting hazards, conducting safety observations, and supporting safety risk assessments. Conduct runway surface condition assessments (GRF). Escort unauthorized drivers within the airside area in accordance with related procedures. Provide aircraft guidance using Follow-Me vehicles when required. Monitor and report fuel spills and other hazardous substance spillages within the airside area. Continuously monitor aircraft turnaround activities within the airside area and report any observed safety non-compliances. Report airside incidents and occurrences and collect all available information to facilitate the investigation process. Support emergency response activities in accordance with established airport emergency procedures. Perform any other duties assigned by the Duty Supervisor and/or Direct Manager within the scope of the position. Experience Required Candidates for this role should have 0-1 years of relevant experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Medina, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia, focusing on airside operations within a dynamic airport environment. Application Process Salary details for this position are not disclosed. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

2de3baecfba503ba.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة طريق الجسر المتخصصة للمقاولات عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال وصيانة المعدات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية ومتابعة التنفيذ. إعداد مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وتحديد مساراتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركة المصنعة والتعليمات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بتشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة مقاولات رائدة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

2d5cb95dddf2dd63.company_name: شركة برمه للتجارة والمقاولات لاصحابها محمد الربيعان واحمد الربيعان
2d5cb95dddf2dd63.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة برمه للتجارة والمقاولات لاصحابها محمد الربيعان واحمد الربيعان عن فني مساحة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مشروع صيانة طريق الغماس - اللسيب، المستلم من فرع وزارة النقل والخدمات اللوجستية. يقع المشروع في مدينة بريدة بمنطقة القصيم، ويهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تنفيذ أعمال المساحة المتنوعة للمشاريع الإنشائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى فني المساحة مسؤولية تنفيذ مجموعة واسعة من المهام المساحية لضمان دقة الأعمال الإنشائية وتوافقها مع المخططات، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستكشافية اللازمة لمختلف المشاريع الإنشائية. إعداد مسودات تفصيلية للمنشآت، العوائق، القنوات، والطرق الفرعية. تحديد وتثبيت نقاط الاستناد الرئيسة والفرعية ونقاط الربط. اختيار أنواع الأجهزة والأدوات المساحية المناسبة لكل مهمة. تنفيذ أعمال التسوية الطولية والعرضية لشبكات البنية التحتية المختلفة. إجراء أعمال التسوية الشبكية لمشاريع الأبنية والأراضي. تثبيت مواقع وحدود الأبنية من المخططات على أرض الواقع. نقل مواقع وحدود الأبنية القائمة وتثبيتها على المخططات. تثبيت مناسيب جميع الأعمال المتعلقة بالمشروع بدقة. تثبيت مسارات الطرق وسكك الحديد وتقاطعاتها. توقيع المنحنيات المختلفة وفقاً للمخططات الهندسية. رسم المقاطع العرضية والطولية، المنحنيات الأفقية والرأسية، والمخططات الكنتورية والمساحية المستخدمة في أعمال المساحة. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال المساحة، مع فهم عميق لمبادئها وتطبيقاتها في مشاريع البنية التحتية والأبنية. يجب أن يكون المرشح قادراً على استخدام الأجهزة المساحية المختلفة بكفاءة عالية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني المساحة ضمن فريق المشروع في موقع العمل، ويتعاون مع المهندسين والفنيين الآخرين لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة ودقة. يتطلب الدور التواجد الميداني بشكل مستمر لتنفيذ المهام المساحية. نوع التوظيف هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتقدم فرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع البنية التحتية الهامة في منطقة القصيم. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

2dee9302a748e038.job_title: أخصائي تطوير الأعمال والتسويق وتجربة الضيوف
2dee9302a748e038.description: المهام والمسؤوليات * تطوير وتنفيذ المبادرات والخطط التسويقية بهدف تعزيز الحضور التسويقي للمنتجع وزيادة نسب الإشغال والإيرادات. * إدارة منصات التواصل الاجتماعي، وتطوير المحتوى وتنفيذ الحملات التسويقية الرقمية. * ابتكار وتطوير العروض والباقات والبرامج الموسمية بما يتوافق مع احتياجات السوق والفئات المستهدفة. * تخطيط وتنظيم الفعاليات والأنشطة والتجارب السياحية والترفيهية داخل المنتجع وخارجه. * تطوير تجربة الضيوف، ومتابعة مستويات رضاهم، واقتراح المبادرات التي تسهم في تحسين جودة الخدمات. * بناء وتطوير الشراكات التجارية والعلاقات مع الشركات والجهات السياحية ومنظمي الرحلات والفعاليات. * متابعة مؤشرات الأداء وإعداد التقارير الدورية وقياس نتائج الأنشطة والمبادرات التسويقية. المؤهلات والمتطلبات * مؤهل علمي مناسب في التسويق أو إدارة الأعمال أو أحد التخصصات ذات الصلة. * خبرة عملية من سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في التسويق أو تطوير الأعمال، ويفضل في قطاع الضيافة والسياحة. * إجادة اللغة الإنجليزية تحدثًا وكتابةً. * خبرة في التسويق الرقمي وإدارة منصات التواصل الاجتماعي وصناعة المحتوى. * مهارات متميزة في التواصل والتفاوض وبناء العلاقات المهنية. * القدرة على التخطيط والتنظيم وإدارة المبادرات والفعاليات. * الإبداع وروح المبادرة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتحقيق الأهداف.

The platform leverages technology initially developed for The Flex, extending it to other property managers to support the launch, operation, and scaling of their businesses through AI automation. Role Overview ******* is seeking a Video Content Editor to translate complex product information into easily understandable content and to identify compelling narratives within the company's development. This full-time role involves direct collaboration with the founder to produce videos for product launches, founder stories, and strategic initiatives, aiming to capture attention, enhance understanding, and drive engagement. Key Responsibilities Transform raw footage, product recordings, and initial concepts into launch films, founder content, social media videos, and advertisements. Contribute to concept development, identify optimal angles, suggest hooks, and determine narrative structures prior to editing. Manage the entire editing process through to final delivery. Create product launch and brand films by integrating storytelling, product demonstrations, and motion graphics to illustrate Base360's capabilities. Develop compelling stories from founder footage, including interviews, conversations, and behind-the-scenes recordings. Produce content tailored for social platforms such as Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn, adapting openings, pacing, and formats for each channel. Develop and test ad creatives, exploring various hooks, messages, and calls to action, and utilize performance insights for iterative improvements. Oversee all post-production aspects, including footage selection, editing, color grading, sound design, music, captions, and final exports. Contribute to defining the company's visual identity by establishing consistent approaches to typography, motion, sound, and composition across video content. Utilize AI tools to generate supporting visuals, voiceovers, and other assets to enhance content or accelerate production. Work Environment and Culture This is a remote, full-time position within an ambitious and entrepreneurial team. The work culture emphasizes rapid execution, direct communication, and accountability. The role requires proactive initiative, creative decision-making, adherence to deadlines, and continuous improvement through feedback. Adaptability to changing priorities and an openness to experimentation are essential. This position is suited for individuals who prioritize both craft and outcome, and who are committed to maintaining high quality in their work. Significant creative ownership, allowing for the introduction of new ideas, development of formats, and shaping of Base360's visual and auditory presence. Direct impact of work on product launches, marketing campaigns, and customer engagement. Potential for career growth into broader creative leadership and involvement in building a video team. Competitive salary and performance incentives. Application Process Candidates interested in this role are encouraged to apply. Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon initial contact.

2d3eefe8b5ae2b58.description: About Abdul Latif Jameel Abdul Latif Jameel is a diversified business comprising independent entities with operations in 30 countries. Established in 1945, the group employs approximately 11,000 people from over 40 nationalities. Its activities span automotive distribution, auto parts manufacturing, financial services, renewable energy, environmental services, health, land and real estate development, logistics, electronics retailing, and media services. The term Abdul Latif Jameel refers to a group of distinct and wholly separate legal entities, not a single corporate entity or conglomerate. The Role of Plant Manager Abdul Latif Jameel is seeking a Plant Manager to oversee operations in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, specifically covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and is crucial for managing the effective installation of vehicle accessories and developing the plant team. Key Responsibilities Manage, monitor, and develop associates by organizing necessary training in accessories installation and other skills. Maintain strong team member relations and ensure fair work rules are implemented. Monitor staff attendance and enforce company procedures related to absences, tardiness, and performance. Implement the annual training plan for all associates, conduct monthly KPI evaluations, and schedule vacations. Maintain the Quality Management System (QMS) in adherence to ISO 9001:2015 regulations. Review and confirm monthly incentives for all plant staff. Coordinate with Quality Control (QC) to address repetitive parts failures or defects and initiate necessary actions. Communicate with the manpower controller regarding associate requirements, including Associate Care and Finance issues. Collaborate with relevant groups (PIO Planning, Main/sub warehouse, and VLD) to resolve delays in accessory delivery and vehicle availability to maintain production. Implement the Toyota Production System (TPS) by improving production methods, safety, and equipment performance to enhance installation quality. Ensure overall plant compliance with standardized procedures, requirements, and applicable environmental regulations. Required Qualifications Demonstrated experience in managing the effective installation of vehicle accessories. Proven ability to develop and monitor teams, including the creation of succession plans within a department. 2-5 years of relevant professional experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, serving operations in Jeddah and Makkah.

2d5e4c0a383da7a2.description: About the Role AbbVie is seeking a Brand Manager Immunology (Saudi National) to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role requires 0-1 years of experience and focuses on leading the comprehension of patient experience insights across Brand and In-Field Teams within the Saudi market. The Brand Manager will develop a Saudi-specific Patient Journey to ensure patient-centric strategies, adhering to AbbVie's Code of Business Conduct, policies, SFDA regulations, and Saudi pharmaceutical promotion codes. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with Brand Team and In-Field Team members (Product Specialists, KAMs, Market Access, Medical) to facilitate cross-stakeholder discussions with HCP and non-HCP stakeholders, including specialist physicians, nurses, clinical pharmacists, P&T committees, Health Cluster leadership, MOH, NUPCO, and patient groups. Synthesize insights to identify target segments across MOH Health Clusters, military, university, National Guard, and private sectors; determine brand positioning; drive Closed Loop Marketing (CLM) engagement and customization; and populate the Brand Plan Insights Chapter. Secure input and cross-stakeholder viewpoints to develop a robust and accurate Saudi Patient Journey, reflecting local realities such as referral pathways, diagnostic delays, monitoring practices, formulary and NUPCO tender cycles, and treatment sequencing. Propose strategic objectives for Brand Team review based on Patient Journey findings, aligned with Vision 2030 Health Sector Transformation priorities, and challenge Brand Team strategies to ensure patient-centricity. Brand Strategy and Execution Ensure all functional deliverables are consistent with global branding and localized for the Saudi market in Arabic and English, with messages that are culturally relevant, emotional, and aligned to the Brand Story. Ensure all promotional materials pass AbbVie's internal review and approval process and comply with SFDA requirements before use. Guide the design and implementation of all marketing activities to meet strategic brand objectives. Ensure all in-field materials, strategies, and tactics are aligned through POA launches, field communication roadmaps, and training to maintain momentum toward strategic brand objectives. Brand Planning and Performance Lead the development of marketing inputs to the Strategic Brand Plan, consolidate the 1-year Tactical Brand Plan, and coordinate preparation of the Long Range Plan (patient and market-share forecasting). 2d230241c2b2262d.description: About V2X Inc. and the Role V2X Inc. is a global company specializing in smart solutions that integrate physical and digital infrastructure. 2d24ef45da7e0a15.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاتحاد الهندسي السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية خطيب وعلمي عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان، صبيا. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، وإعداد برامج الصيانة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات لخطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. وضع برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر، ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بشبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإدارة عمليات الصيانة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التحليل وحل المشكلات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل وعرض جيدة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة صبيا، جازان. يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة الاتحاد الهندسي السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية خطيب وعلمي، ويسهم في مشاريع هندسية متنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن. سيتم تحديد تفاصيل الراتب خلال عملية المقابلة.

2d7b172ef32df44a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخفجي. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، وصيانة المعدات والشبكات الكهربائية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية، بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر، ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بشبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال ووضع حلول للصيانة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات، ويقع في الخفجي، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب العمل التواجد في الموقع لمتابعة المشاريع وتنفيذ المهام. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

2d98959d2ab60a5a.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة سالك لتأجير السيارات عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وتقدم فرصة للمرشحين الطموحين لبدء مسيرتهم المهنية في بيئة ديناميكية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء والترحيب بهم، وتحديد متطلباتهم، وتزويدهم بالمعلومات اللازمة. إبلاغ المرجع المعني بوصول المراجعين والعملاء وإرشادهم إليه. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية والرد على الاستفسارات أو تحويلها إلى القسم المختص. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية للحصول على المعلومات المطلوبة. ترتيب مواعيد المقابلات وتسجيل أسماء المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بمهنية عالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة عمل منظمة تدعم الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المحددة لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. نشجع المرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

2dc5ea4d717dbae5.description: About the Role Parsons is seeking a Senior ICT / ELV Engineer to lead the design coordination and technical delivery of ICT, communications, security, automation, and extra-low-voltage systems. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is for a major luxury high-end development project. Key Responsibilities Lead coordination efforts for ICT, ELV, security, telecommunications, and smart-building systems. Review structured cabling, Wi-Fi, network infrastructure, telephony, IPTV, access control, CCTV, intercom, public address, AV, BMS interfaces, and specialist systems. Coordinate ICT/ELV requirements with architecture, interiors, MEP, security, operator systems, FF&E, OS&E, and specialist vendors. Review system architecture, equipment rooms, racks, pathways, containment, outlets, interfaces, and maintenance requirements. Ensure technology systems are scalable, resilient, secure, interoperable, and aligned with project standards. Review submissions from contractors, vendors, and specialist system providers. Coordinate technology requirements for guestrooms, public areas, restaurants, meeting rooms, wellness facilities, back-of-house, staff areas, and external spaces. Support cybersecurity, data protection, network resilience, and system integration requirements. Review RFIs, substitutions, shop drawings, programming requirements, and proposed design changes. Coordinate testing, commissioning, integrated systems testing, training, and handover processes. Support mock-up rooms, technology demonstrations, proof-of-concept installations, and operational trials. Maintain system schedules, interface matrices, and technical compliance records. Provide technical guidance to both design and project teams. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 12 years of experience in ICT and ELV systems. Demonstrated expertise in leading design coordination and technical delivery for complex technology systems. Work Environment This is a full-time position within Parsons, contributing to a significant luxury development project in Riyadh. The role requires collaboration with various internal and external stakeholders, including architects, engineers, vendors, and specialist teams. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join the Parsons team in Riyadh.

2da4bef6103f5812.description: About V2X V2X is a global company that develops smart solutions to integrate physical and digital infrastructure, supporting missions from base to battlefield. With 120 years of experience, V2X focuses on improving security, streamlining logistics, and enhancing readiness. The company, comprising 16,000 employees, works with clients to address complex challenges with integrity, respect, responsibility, and professionalism. Role Overview: UH60M Instructor Pilot V2X is seeking an experienced UH60M Instructor Pilot to provide advanced instruction in Riyadh. This full-time role involves conducting initial ATP integration, continuation training, the Initial Aircraft Qualification Course (AQC), and Aircraft Qualification Training (AQT). The instructor will evaluate employee and customer crewmembers based on US Army Aircrew Training Manual (ATM) and MNG Modernization Training Plan requirements. Duties include delivering academic and hands-on performance training, administering evaluations for aircrew proficiency, and maintaining Individual Aircrew Training Folders (IATF) with necessary training, currency, and readiness entries. Key Responsibilities Train and evaluate Aviation pilots in the UH60M aircraft according to US Army ATM and unit ATP guidelines. Support the development and execution of an Aviation Aircrew Training Program as per customer guidance. Verify and confirm that all required flight training publications are current and complete. Conduct and evaluate individual readiness level progression tasks, including instrument flight tasks during day, night, night vision system (NVS), night vision goggle (NVG), and instrument flight rules (IFR). Prepare crewmembers through realistic mission training flight maneuvers under local environmental conditions, including dust landings and weather-specific desert training. Provide aircrew proficiency training in Instrument Meteorological Conditions (IMC) within and outside controlled airspace under Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and/or International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) flight rules. Attend meetings as required by customers. Recommend aviation instructor pilot and Pilot in Command appointments to customer leadership. Attend and provide training and mission planning input to weekly scheduling meetings based on ATP requirements. Act as an ATP mentor within the company standardization and battalion standardization team as needed by the customer, including Master Gunner training and mentorship. Provide guidance and mentorship for field exercises at tenant locations. Perform IP duties at offsite locations based on customer needs. Operate within broad guidelines of duties and responsibilities with significant choice of methods. Select and implement goals and objectives within the execution of duties and responsibilities. May be assigned as project lead to support program goals within the guidance of the PWS, including technical writing of aviation documents. Perform additional duties as directed by management. Required Qualifications and Experience Associate's degree or higher is required due to visa requirements. Successful completion of the Saudi Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development’s Qualification Verification Program (QVP) is required for visa processing and employment authorization in Saudi Arabia. Must have been qualified as a Pilot in Command. Graduate of the UH60M Instructor Pilot Course (IPC)/Methods of Instruction (MOI) course at an authorized * Army Aviation Proponent School or an IP equivalency evaluation administered by a standardization instructor pilot (SP) selected by the Directorate of Evaluations and Standardization (DES) is required. Qualified on the UH60M Series Aircraft is required. Minimum of 1500 total flight hours (total time). Minimum of 500 flight hours as an Instructor Pilot. FAA Commercial Pilot certificate is required. Successful completion of the FAA Class II Flight Physical upon hire, and annually thereafter, is required. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with potential requirements for duties at offsite locations based on customer needs.

2dedf0639364e5c0.description: About the Role PSA BDP is seeking a Project and Heavy Lift Manager to join their team in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing the commercial development, bidding, procurement, planning, coordination, and execution of project cargo and heavy lift movements. The manager will ensure safe, timely, and cost-effective delivery in line with customer and company requirements. Key Responsibilities Develop and expand the Projects & Heavy Lift business, identifying new opportunities and strengthening relationships with key customers and industry stakeholders. Lead commercial proposals, tenders, pricing, and contract negotiations, collaborating with the Sales team to secure new projects. Oversee the planning and execution of project cargo, heavy lift, and complex transportation activities, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and according to customer requirements. Manage project resources, subcontractors, and operational service providers, monitoring performance and addressing challenges. Take ownership of the financial performance and profitability of the Saudi Projects & Heavy Lift business, managing annual budgets, revenue targets, gross profit, and operating costs. Monitor project costs, margins, cash flow, and financial performance, providing regular business forecasts and performance reports. Lead, manage, and develop team members within the Projects & Heavy Lift department, setting clear objectives and ensuring accountability. Ensure compliance with local regulations, company policies, and industry requirements, maintaining high standards of health, safety, security, and environmental practices. Work closely with regional leadership to implement the MEA Projects & Heavy Lift business strategy and support regional business opportunities. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in project cargo and heavy lift management. Demonstrated ability to manage commercial development, bidding, procurement, and execution of complex logistics projects. Experience in financial management, including budgeting, cost control, and profitability analysis. Proven leadership and team management skills. Strong understanding of compliance, safety, and risk management principles in logistics operations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia, requiring close collaboration with internal teams, external stakeholders, and regional leadership.

2df6ba3b063d076c.description: Cooperative Training Program Overview SABIC is offering Cooperative Training (Co-op) opportunities for university and college students. This program is designed to provide practical experience and professional development within a leading organization. The internships are available across SABIC's locations in Saudi Arabia, specifically in Al Jubail, Riyadh, and Yanbu. This is an internship position with 0-1 years of experience required. Program Purpose The Cooperative Training Program aims to equip students with hands-on experience and real workplace exposure. Participants will engage in daily tasks and projects, working alongside professional teams and mentors to develop essential skills for their future careers. Fields of Study SABIC welcomes applications from students across various technical and administrative disciplines. These include, but are not limited to, the following areas: Engineering disciplines (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Industrial) Information Technology & Computer Science Business Administration, Human Resources, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain Training Experience During the training period, students will undertake a range of activities designed to foster their professional growth. Key aspects of the training include: Gaining practical experience through involvement in real projects and daily operational tasks. Collaborating closely with professional teams and receiving guidance from assigned mentors. Developing technical, administrative, and communication skills relevant to their field of study. Building a foundational understanding that supports future career opportunities within their chosen profession. Application Information Students who are motivated and eager to acquire practical experience that complements their academic and professional development are encouraged to apply for the upcoming Co-op program. The salary for this internship is not disclosed.

2d08197dcf13d80e.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking an HVAC Technician to join its team in Makkah. This full-time position is responsible for ensuring all refrigeration and air-conditioning equipment and installations are maintained in optimal working condition through necessary repairs and preventive maintenance. The role requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Address all refrigeration and A/C trouble reports on a daily basis, prioritizing guest room issues. Collaborate with A/C and Refrigeration Technicians/Foremen and peers to execute preventive maintenance and annual maintenance programs. Adhere to all safety rules and regulations pertinent to the job, departmental procedures, and instructions. Perform other tasks as assigned by the supervisor. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in HVAC maintenance or a related field. Demonstrated ability to perform repairs and preventive maintenance on refrigeration and air-conditioning equipment. Understanding of safety protocols and regulations in a technical work environment. About Hilton Hilton is a global leader in hospitality, recognized for its commitment to both guest experiences and fostering an exceptional workplace culture. The company has been repeatedly acknowledged on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. Hilton operates a suite of world-class brands, dedicated to providing quality stays and setting new standards in the travel industry. Work Location This position is based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join the Hilton team.

2d32f6f7478bab33.description: About SYSTRA SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA designs transport solutions to connect people and facilitate access to employment, education, and leisure. For 65 years, the Group has supported cities and regions in developing, improving, and modernizing their infrastructure and transport systems across the project lifecycle, from design to deployment and maintenance. Operating in over 80 countries, SYSTRA generates 74% of its turnover internationally and supports clients in their digital, ecological, and energy transitions. The Role of Project Manager - Transportation & Mobility SYSTRA is seeking an experienced Project Manager with over 10 years of experience in construction project management and Transportation & Mobility. This full-time role involves leading the end-to-end delivery for a high-profile investment program in Riyadh and Makkah. The Project Manager will specifically manage the PPP contract for the development of bus stations and Park & Ride (P&R) facilities in Makkah, overseeing the procurement process, design, and construction stages. Key responsibilities include contract administration, stakeholder coordination, performance monitoring, and ensuring compliance with contractual obligations. The role requires guiding multidisciplinary teams to meet contractual requirements, performance targets, and project benefits, while adhering to timelines and budgets. Key Responsibilities Provide end-to-end advisory leadership across the project lifecycle, including design review, commercial support, and implementation monitoring for bus and BRT programs. Manage the PPP contract, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, scope of work, risk allocation, performance requirements, key milestones, and deliverables throughout design and construction. Serve as the direct interface with public authorities, operators, consultants, and community stakeholders, facilitating governance, approvals, and public communications. Manage program controls, including schedule, cost, risk, and quality, by establishing PMO structures, KPIs, stage-gates, and reporting dashboards. Review and assure designs for road infrastructure (corridors, stations, depots), ITS, fare collection, and priority measures, coordinating across traffic engineering, urban design, utilities, and safety. Drive operational readiness planning (ORAT), service change management, and transition to operations, including safety management systems and incident response. Champion user experience, accessibility, equity, and reliability through data-driven service performance management. Integrate sustainability and resilience outcomes, such as emissions reduction, energy efficiency, and climate adaptation, aligning with ESG and client policy targets. Mentor teams, build client relationships, and identify business development opportunities, proposals, and thought leadership. Candidate Requirements A minimum of 10 years of experience in project management, with a strong focus on construction projects. Demonstrated expertise in the Transportation & Mobility sector. Proven ability to manage PPP contracts and ensure compliance with complex contractual obligations. Experience in leading multidisciplinary teams and coordinating with diverse stakeholders. Strong understanding of program controls, including schedule, cost, risk, and quality management. Work Location and Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh and Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves managing projects critical to the region's transportation infrastructure development.

2d7094bbb21fc6db.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة مهارة للموارد البشرية عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بدوام كامل لمهندس مدني في مدينة الرياض. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية تخطيط ومتابعة والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع والأعمال الإنشائية في الموقع، مع ضمان مطابقة الأعمال للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية المعتمدة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان تنفيذ المشاريع وفقاً للمتطلبات الهندسية المعتمدة، مع الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية المحددة ومعايير الجودة والسلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ الأعمال الإنشائية ومتابعة سير العمل في الموقع. مراجعة المخططات والرسومات الهندسية والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية المعتمدة. متابعة تقدم الأعمال الإنشائية لضمان الالتزام بالجدول الزمني وخطة التنفيذ. مراقبة جودة الأعمال المنفذة والتأكد من مطابقتها للمعايير الهندسية. التنسيق الفعال مع المقاولين والاستشاريين والفرق الفنية لضمان تنفيذ الأعمال بكفاءة. متابعة استخدام المواد الإنشائية والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات المعتمدة. التأكد من الالتزام التام باشتراطات السلامة المهنية ومتطلبات الجودة في الموقع. إعداد التقارير الفنية الدورية وتوثيق تقدم الأعمال والملاحظات الميدانية. متابعة الملاحظات الفنية والعمل على معالجتها بالتنسيق مع الجهات المعنية. المؤهلات والمتطلبات شهادة جامعية في الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على تخطيط ومتابعة والإشراف على المشاريع الإنشائية. معرفة قوية بالمخططات والمواصفات الفنية الهندسية. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية في مواقع العمل. تفاصيل الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الراتب الشهري المحدد لهذا الدور هو 8,500 ريال سعودي. عن مهارة للموارد البشرية تعد مهارة للموارد البشرية إحدى الشركات الرائدة في توفير حلول الموارد البشرية المتكاملة، وتلتزم بتقديم فرص وظيفية تساهم في تطوير الكفاءات المهنية. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المدنيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

2ddcb78be86eab08.description: About the Role Accor is seeking a Credit Manager (Saudi National) for SLS The Red Sea. This full-time role is essential for maintaining the hotel's financial health by managing credit operations, overseeing accounts receivable, and ensuring timely collections. The Credit Manager will also be responsible for fostering strong relationships with guests and business partners. Role Context and Collaboration The Credit Manager will work closely with the Finance, Sales, Events, and Front Office teams. Key responsibilities include assessing credit risks, managing outstanding balances, maintaining accurate financial records, and ensuring compliance with hotel policies and financial regulations. This position requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Oversee the hotel's credit operations and accounts receivable to ensure effective financial control and healthy cash flow. Review and approve credit applications for corporate clients, groups, and other business partners in line with hotel policies. Establish and monitor credit limits and payment terms in coordination with the Director of Finance. Ensure accurate and timely invoicing, billing, and collection of outstanding payments. Monitor accounts receivable aging reports and follow up on overdue balances to minimize financial risks. Maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, travel partners, and guests while resolving billing and payment disputes. Work closely with Sales, Events, and Front Office teams to ensure credit procedures are consistently followed. Prepare monthly credit reports, aging summaries, reconciliations, and bad debt provisions. Ensure compliance with Saudi regulations, accounting standards, company policies, and internal audit requirements. Maintain accurate credit and billing records using hotel financial systems such as Opera, Sun Systems, and Micros. Identify opportunities to improve credit control procedures, collection efficiency, and financial reporting. Support financial audits by maintaining complete and accurate documentation. Provide guidance and training to relevant departments on credit policies, billing procedures, and financial controls. Report credit performance, outstanding balances, and potential financial risks to the Director of Finance. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in hotel accounting or finance, including at least 2 years in a supervisory or managerial role. Previous experience in luxury or lifestyle hospitality is preferred. Required Skills and Knowledge Strong knowledge of credit control, accounts receivable, collections, and financial reporting. Good understanding of IFRS, Saudi financial regulations, and internal financial controls. Experience with hotel financial systems such as Opera, Sun Systems, and Micros. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across departments. Ability to handle confidential financial information with professionalism and integrity.

2df112d95a5aa4df.description: About the Role GRG is seeking a Human Resources Business Partner to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This role is within a leading multinational organization in the FMCG and consumer goods sector. The position requires a commercially minded HR leader capable of partnering with senior stakeholders, addressing complex people challenges, and driving business transformation. 2d1543234027d647.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الرائد المتحدة للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تصميم المباني والإشراف على تنفيذها، ويقدم فرصة للمهندسين المعماريين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية لاكتساب خبرة قيمة في مشاريع متنوعة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم المباني الجديدة، أو الإضافات والتعديلات على المباني القائمة. تقديم الاستشارات الفنية المتعلقة بترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. المساعدة في اختيار المواقع المناسبة للمشاريع ومباشرة أعمال الإنشاءات. وضع التصاميم المعمارية لمشاريع الإنشاءات وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات الفنية. إعداد النماذج بالحجم الطبيعي، والرسومات الهندسية، والنماذج الرقمية للمشاريع. المساعدة في عملية اختيار المقاولين والمواد الإنشائية. تقديم الدعم الفني لمشروعات الإنشاء والإشراف على تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاولين. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. درجة جامعية في الهندسة المعمارية أو مجال ذي صلة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المعماري ضمن فريق شركة الرائد المتحدة للاستشارات الهندسية في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع للإشراف على المشاريع وتنفيذ المهام التصميمية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المعماريين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

2da1bd98bbc29db7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة عراب نجد للمقاولات عن مهندس سلامة وصحة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى إعداد وتطوير أسس وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية في مواقع العمل، وتحديد المخاطر، وتوفير مستلزمات السلامة لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتطوير أسس وإجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية، مثل سياسة السلامة وتعليمات العمل الآمن والإخلاء ولجان السلامة، ومتابعة الالتزام بها. تحديد الأخطار المهنية الميكانيكية والكهربائية والكيميائية في مواقع العمل، ووضع الإشارات والملصقات التحذيرية اللازمة. إعداد قوائم بمواصفات ومستلزمات السلامة والصحة المهنية، ومتابعة توفيرها وضمان استخدامها من قبل العاملين. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال السلامة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال السلامة والصحة المهنية. معرفة قوية بأسس وقواعد وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على تحديد الأخطار المهنية ووضع خطط لتفاديها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. القدرة على التواصل الفعال مع فرق العمل المختلفة. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق مؤسسة عراب نجد للمقاولات. ستعمل في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية العالية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

2dd677f23d6aafe7.company_name: مكتب محمد بن عبدالله بن محمد ابابطين للمحاماة
2dd677f23d6aafe7.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب كفاءة الشرق للخدمات العامة عن محامٍ للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. يتولى المحامي مسؤولية دراسة القضايا وتجهيز ملفاتها، وجمع البينات والأدلة، بالإضافة إلى متابعة الدعاوى والمرافعة فيها أمام المحاكم المختلفة. يشمل الدور أيضاً تمثيل الموكلين وتنظيم العقود والاتفاقيات القانونية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال القضايا، تحديد نوعها، تحليل عناصرها، وتقديم الرأي القانوني بشأنها. تحديد وجمع البينات الخطية (الوثائق والمستندات) والشخصية (شهود الدفاع والإثبات) وأدلة الإثبات، وكتابة لوائح الدعوى وتحضير حافظات المستندات. مراجعة المحاكم المختصة لتقديم الدعاوى ومتابعة تبليغ المدعى عليهم، وحضور الجلسات والمرافعة حتى صدور الحكم. تمثيل الموكلين (مدعين أو مدعى عليهم) أمام مختلف درجات المحاكم واللجان والمجالس الرسمية والمحكمين. تقديم المدافعة والمرافعة والإنذارات العدلية والعادية والاعتراضات والمطالبات للموكلين. المفاوضة بشأن العقود والاتفاقيات مع الجهات الرسمية وغير الرسمية، وصياغتها وتوثيقها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمحاماة وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المحاماة. القدرة على دراسة القضايا وتحليلها بشكل دقيق. مهارات ممتازة في جمع البينات والأدلة القانونية. إتقان صياغة لوائح الدعوى والمستندات القانونية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مكتب كفاءة الشرق للخدمات العامة، وتقع في مدينة الرياض. تتطلب الوظيفة العمل ضمن فريق قانوني متخصص، مع التركيز على تقديم خدمات قانونية عالية الجودة للموكلين. معلومات إضافية يُطلب من المتقدمين أن يكونوا قادرين على تمثيل الموكلين بفعالية أمام الجهات القضائية والرسمية، مع الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في إعداد وحفظ الوثائق القانونية.

2d52a886f0ec96f7.job_title: Principal Engineer AI & HPC Solutions Architect
2d52a886f0ec96f7.description: About the Role KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology) is seeking a highly motivated and skilled HPC Senior Systems Administrator to join the KAUST Supercomputing Laboratory (KSL). This full-time position is based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing an HPC cluster, storage systems, and networks, while providing comprehensive support to researchers and end-users across various computational domains. Key Responsibilities Provide timely and effective user support via multiple channels, maintaining high customer service standards. Install, configure, and manage HPC subsystems, including approximately 600 CPU and GPU nodes, high-performance storage systems, InfiniBand, Ethernet, and configuration management tools (*, Ansible, Puppet). Deploy and manage cluster management software, monitoring tools, and supporting services for HPC clusters. Install and administer the Slurm workload manager, including QOS policies, accounts, accounting, and related automation scripts (Python and C++). Develop and maintain automation scripts in Bash and Python to streamline system administration tasks. Deploy and manage container environments (Singularity/Apptainer, Docker) for HPC workloads. Benchmark HPC system components periodically to ensure optimal performance and identify tuning opportunities. Enforce security best practices, including node hardening, kernel patching, and compliance across all systems. Manage parallel file systems such as Lustre, GPFS, Weka, or Vast, including performance tuning and capacity planning. Directly support research activities in computational science, engineering, data analysis, and AI/ML in collaboration with application support teams. Develop software tools and utilities as needed to support research projects on cluster systems. Drive proof-of-concept projects, technology evaluations, and advocate for system enhancements based on industry best practices. Coordinate with vendors and third-party service providers to resolve issues. Develop and maintain user documentation, standard operating procedures, and training materials. Stay informed on HPC advancements through continuous learning and professional collaboration, informing future hardware procurement. Required Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in HPC systems administration. Strong expertise in Linux system administration (RHEL, Rocky Linux, or CentOS) in large-scale HPC environments. Demonstrated track record of managing complex HPC systems, including parallel file systems, job schedulers, InfiniBand/Ethernet networks, and monitoring systems. Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, or equivalent). Proficiency with HPC applications and programming models (Fortran, C/C++, Python, MPI, OpenMP, CUDA, OpenACC). Familiarity with computational science, data analysis, and AI/ML applications and libraries used in HPC environments. Knowledge of project management principles and practices. Competencies and Skills Expertise in supporting users of computational science and engineering, data analysis, and artificial intelligence applications and libraries. Demonstrated ability to support research activities in a highly collaborative HPC environment. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Proactive in identifying and implementing system improvements, taking initiative, and seeing tasks through to closure. Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and deliver high-quality results within deadlines. Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, application teams, and vendors. Effective in multi-cultural, international work environments. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, including the ability to prepare and deliver technical reports and presentations.

2d1b04e00a63c91d.job_title: Estimation Engineer (Civil / Mechanical / Electrical - Oil & Gas)
2d1b04e00a63c91d.description: Job description We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Estimation Engineer (Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical) to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for preparing complete, accurate, and competitive cost estimates and commercial proposals for major Oil & Gas projects Key Responsibilities: Review and evaluate client tender packages, including project scope, ITT documents, specifications, commercial terms, and engineering drawings (P&IDs, Isometrics, Layouts, SLDs, Structural/Civil drawings). Identify project risks, commercial implications, and site constraints to incorporate proper risk margins and allowances in bid estimates. Prepare comprehensive commercial and technical proposal submissions in alignment with client requirements and company standards.
